CHAPA DIMBA NA SAFARICOM
Season 2 of the Chapa Dimba Na Safaricom is a national football tournament for male and female youth aged between
16-20 years. The aims of the tournament are to transform the lives of young people by giving them a platform to showcase
their talent and an opportunity to earn from their passion. The tournament was launched in July 2018 and run until June
2019, engaging approximately 1,500 boys and girl’s teams from across the country with over 33,000 players taking part in the
tournament and over 5,000 games played.
